purpose: Local noncommercial cow identity experiments; datasets and weights are not redistributed

dataset.name: MultiCamCows2024
dataset.license: Non-Commercial Government Licence for public sector information
dataset.selection: Original cropped images, 2023Aug14 enrollment and 2023Aug20 query; deterministic identity-disjoint calibration/test split
dataset.fingerprints: Every selected file SHA256 and split assignment recorded in run manifest.json
dataset.limitations: Existing public benchmark, repeatedly explored locally; not independently held-out farm footage

models.name: DINOv2-small
models.preprocessing: Application DinoEncoder: full RGB crop, bicubic square padding, ImageNet normalization, FP32 normalized CLS embedding
models.overlap: LVD-142M source images not completely auditable

models.name: MIEWid msv3
models.license: None stated on the model card or in the publisher's repository (checked 2026-10-09); local noncommercial experiment with the official checkpoint, no redistribution
models.preprocessing: RGB bilinear square stretch 440, ImageNet normalization, EfficientNetV2 rw_m + learned GeM + BatchNorm, FP32 normalized embedding
models.overlap: Publisher describes wildlife training, complete identity-level overlap unknown

models.name: MegaDescriptor-S-224
models.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 model card; local noncommercial experiment
models.preprocessing: Pinned timm config: bicubic short-side resize, center crop 224 with crop_pct0.9, ImageNet normalization, FP32 normalized Swin embedding
models.overlap: Trained on WildlifeDatasets collection including cattle datasets; exact identity overlap unknown

models.name: MegaDescriptor-B-224
models.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 model card; local noncommercial experiment
models.preprocessing: Two separate controls: pinned timm config bicubic short-side resize/center crop224(.9), and publisher inference notebook bilinear full-image stretch224. Both ImageNet-normalized; distinct cache fingerprints.
models.overlap: Trained on WildlifeDatasets collection including cattle datasets; exact identity overlap unknown

models.name: Cutie base mega
models.preprocessing: Official generic eval config, RGB0–1, FP32, shortestedge480, long-term memory enabled, mem_every5; reviewed research runner loads complete official checkpoint strictly.
models.scope: Separate noncommercial research-only manually initialized video tracking control; no application dependency or accuracy claim from initial smoke.

video_smoke.name: 8-calves
video_smoke.selection: First 30 seconds of pmfeed_4_3_16.mp4 at 1 fps; first-frame publisher IDs 1 and 3 for enrollment only
video_smoke.annotations: Existing numeric NPZ conversion, allow_pickle=False; source pickle is SHA256-verified, never loaded or executed
video_smoke.detector: Cached standard Ultralytics YOLO26m-seg, COCO cow class only, FP32 on MPS
video_smoke.fingerprints: Full source-video, source-pickle, annotation NPZ and both model hashes recorded in runtime-smoke.json
video_smoke.limitation: Same-clip integration evidence only, not independent recognition accuracy
